title: On a relatively open flat region of density k, almost every point is a carrier point with multiplicity k and approximate tangent plane Q
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), Q ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with dim Q = n, G ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1, and R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) with R.Represents C. Assume every y ∈ G satisfies: y ∈ Q, HasMassDensity C y k, and there is r > 0 with Q ∩ B_r(y) ⊆ G and spt C ∩ B_r(y) ⊆ Q. Then for μHE[n]-a.e. y ∈ ℝ^P: if y ∈ G, then y ∈ M, θ(y) = k and approxTangentPlane n M y = Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (G : Set (Euclid P)) (k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → 1 ≤ k → (∀ y ∈ G, y ∈ Q ∧ HasMassDensity C y k ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball y r ⊆ G ∧ C.support ∩ ball y r ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) → R.Represents C → ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), y ∈ G → y ∈ R.carrier ∧ R.mult y = k ∧ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier y = Q
